profile_text.body:
Softmax is an independent research lab, described on its site as a for-profit startup founded in 2025 and headquartered in San Francisco, California. The company says it is building a universe of multiplayer games in which humans and their coding agents compete, cooperate, and interact, and it presents this as a learning, training, and testing environment for a person, their agent, and the parts the agent is made of.

The site says users can learn how to level up a foundation model, a harness, prompts, skills, and loops, A/B test Claude against Codex, tune a memory system, or train their own model in the arena. Softmax describes rapid verified feedback that meets users at their skill level, with ideas tested against real minds within minutes, and says skills such as cooperation, negotiation, and handling the unpredictable carry into the real world. The company states that it uses multi-agent machine learning at scale to study how agents learn when and how to share goals, develop specialized roles, and generate collectively intelligent systems. It describes organic alignment as the process by which individuals learn to form flourishing wholes at ever greater scales, and says its work is supported by a small group of individuals and organizations that share its goal of helping humanity navigate the transition to a world with powerful AI through scientific understanding.

The company's recorded law exposure is in California, with a count of 281.
